description: Defines the egl::Config class and ConfigSet class, describing EGL surface configurations including format, size, and attributes, for use in EGL context creation and surface management.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Represents an EGL configuration with various format and attribute parameters.

classes.name: ConfigSet
classes.description: Manages a collection of Config objects, allowing addition, retrieval, filtering, and iteration.

methods.name: add(const Config &config)
methods.description: Adds a Config to the ConfigSet.

methods.name: get(EGLint id) const
methods.description: Retrieves a Config by its ID.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Clears all Configs from the ConfigSet.

methods.name: size() const
methods.description: Returns the number of Configs in the set.

methods.name: contains(const Config *config) const
methods.description: Checks if a Config is in the set.

methods.name: filter(const AttributeMap &attributeMap) const
methods.description: Filters Configs based on attribute criteria.

methods.name: begin()
methods.description: Returns iterator to beginning of ConfigMap.

methods.name: end()
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of ConfigMap.
